summary: Preinstall-triggered native addon exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials to oob.s4yhii.com
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node index.js` that loads a prebuilt native addon from prebuilds/<platform>-<arch>/metrics.node. The addon reads a hardcoded list of CI/cloud credential environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN, AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT) together with hostname, username, OS/arch/release and current working directory, assembles a JSON record, opens a TCP socket to oob.s4yhii.com and sends an HTTP POST to /native. The exfiltration logic resides entirely inside compiled linux-x64 and win32-x64.node binaries; the package ships no C/C++ source, no binding.gyp, and the JS surface is a stub NestJS-shaped `forRoot/createLogger` API unrelated to the native code. Internal markers in src/archetype/package.json (`_marker: s4yhii-poc-2026-10-09`, `_contact: jesusitpro22@gmail.com`) and the scoped name resembling an organization toolkit indicate a typosquat/supply-chain payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
